title: The Boy Who Never Cleaned His Room: The Missing Teddy!

lines.text: Leo loved building block castles, racing cars, and drawing monsters!
lines.caps: Leo loved building block *CASTLES, | racing cars, and *DRAWING | *MONSTERS!

lines.text: When playtime ended, he left all his toys scattered across the floor!
lines.caps: When playtime *ENDED, | he left all his toys *SCATTERED | across the *FLOOR!

lines.text: At bedtime, his favorite cuddly teddy bear was nowhere to be found!
lines.caps: At bedtime, his favorite *CUDDLY | teddy bear was nowhere to *BE | *FOUND!

lines.text: He searched under toy mountains, tripping over plastic bricks and cars!
lines.caps: He searched under toy *MOUNTAINS, | tripping over plastic *BRICKS | and *CARS!

lines.text: Ouch! Stepping on scattered toys hurts little feet and breaks things!
lines.caps: *OUCH! Stepping on scattered *TOYS | hurts little feet and *BREAKS | *THINGS!

lines.text: Leo turned on the tidy-up music and raced to put toys into their colorful bins!
lines.caps: Leo turned on the *TIDY-UP | music and raced to put toys into their *COLORFUL | *BINS!

lines.text: And there at the very bottom was teddy, smiling safe and sound!
lines.caps: And there at the very *BOTTOM | was teddy, smiling *SAFE | and *SOUND!

lines.text: Cleaning up your toys keeps your room safe and your treasures protected!
lines.caps: Cleaning up your *TOYS | keeps your room safe and your *TREASURES | *PROTECTED!

lines.text: Tidy up with a smile and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
lines.caps: *TIDY up with | a smile and *SUBSCRIBE | to *BABYBEATS | *RHYMO!
